en: The image shows a painted scene of a steep funicular railway ascending a lush, green hillside. At the base, there are ornate historical buildings with red tile roofs. At the top of the hill, there is a prominent structure resembling a gate or station, and to the right, a domed building with a cross, likely a church or chapel. The setting suggests a European city with significant elevation changes and a famous hilltop landmark.
